# SB-1001 — Safety bulletin: noise exposure

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-IH02

Hazard description
- Operators and maintenance personnel working at Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) are exposed to elevated continuous and intermittent noise during routine charging, heating, and billet handling operations. Prolonged exposure can cause temporary or permanent hearing degradation and increases the risk of communication failures during critical lifts and equipment adjustments. Noise sources include induction cycle transitions, billet feed impacts, and material handling steps adjacent to the heater.

Affected equipment
- Primary: EQ-P2-L1-IH02 (Hot Forge induction billet heater #2). Target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C.  
- Secondary: local material handling and feed systems associated with the EQ-P2-L1-IH02 work area. Refer to MM-P2-L1-IH02 for maintenance history and recent modifications that influence acoustic emissions.

Required controls
- Administrative: implement controlled access to the immediate work zone during active heating and charging cycles. Update shift briefings to emphasize noise hazards and communication signals specific to EQ-P2-L1-IH02. Review applicable procedures in SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-05 to ensure alignment of noise mitigation with operational steps and lockout/tagout practices.
- Personal protective equipment: require approved hearing protection for all personnel in the defined zone. Ensure fit-check and training per site PPE program before assignment to tasks with EQ-P2-L1-IH02.
- Engineering and work-practice: where feasible, schedule noisy operations when nonessential personnel are absent; use spot shielding and dampening at feed/impact points; prioritize vibration isolation during maintenance activities documented in MM-P2-L1-IH02.
- Verification: supervisors shall confirm compliance at shift start and record observations in line logs; escalate repeat exceedances to Maintenance and Safety for corrective action.

Effective date
- Effective date: Rev E. Review references MM-P2-L1-IH02, SOP-P2-L1-01, SOP-P2-L1-05 for related requirements and implementation details.
